basis.description: Conditional current-state experiment because the present Schur derivatives for lever_x, lever_y, lever_z, axis_spacing, pupil1 and pupil2 are weak. Omit only these six active chart directions and retain their supplied resume values as conditional assumptions; do not reset them to zero or replace them with historical values. This is not a Sony measurement or a calibrated installation. Keep the centered constant principal point, square-pixel assumptions, other optics and existing joint scene of square_center_pp_joint.
